title: Canonical serialization
requirement: Define exactly one versioned canonical byte representation for every rooted object, contract, receipt, event, view, delta, and authority object. Reject noncanonical encodings at the authority boundary.
theorem: Core: Canonical Rendering Identity; Q99: Rendering Fragmentation Penalty
acceptance_test: Property tests produce identical bytes under map-order, whitespace, path-alias, locale, and process-order perturbations; malformed/noncanonical inputs are rejected.

title: Content roots
requirement: Compute collision-resistant roots over canonical bytes and bind the digest algorithm/version into every root. Never use display names, timestamps, or database row IDs as semantic identity.
acceptance_test: Mutation of any canonical field changes the root; identical content in separate processes and branches yields the same root.

title: Formation receipts
requirement: A stored payload receives cache authority only through a receipt that binds constructor identity, contract root, complete dependency roots, execution record, payload root, and formation time/epoch.
acceptance_test: Relabeling an unrelated payload with a valid causal key fails verification; dependency or constructor mutation revokes reuse.

title: Trivalent epistemic verdict
requirement: Every checker returns Safe, Unsafe, or Unknown. Unknown never aliases Safe and cannot issue execution or publication authority.
theorem: Core: Decision-View Certificate Soundness; Harness: Atomic No-Partial-Authority
acceptance_test: Fault injection that removes one required premise always yields Unknown or Unsafe, never Completed.

title: Typed authority separation
requirement: Planner, model, retriever, cache optimizer, and executor code cannot construct authority objects. Only trusted checkers may issue short-lived scoped authority after validating rooted evidence.
theorem: Harness: Atomic No-Partial-Authority; Pareto: Same-Harness Capability Superset
acceptance_test: Static/module-boundary audit plus runtime forgery tests show that fabricated, replayed, expired, scope-mismatched, or stale authorities fail.

title: Append-only authoritative event log
requirement: Record every state transition, evidence observation, cache decision, execution, verification, authority issuance, commit, rollback, and resource charge in an append-only sequence with parent roots.
acceptance_test: A killed process can replay the log to the same authoritative state; missing or reordered events are detectable.

title: Versioned semantic ABI
requirement: Root the ABI version for task contracts, semantic objects, receipts, events, and results. Schema migration must be explicit and never silently reinterpret old bytes.
acceptance_test: Golden fixtures decode identically across supported releases; incompatible versions fail closed or migrate with a rooted receipt.

title: No partial authority
requirement: All authoritative project mutations are atomic: either an exact verified successor root becomes current or the authoritative root is unchanged.
acceptance_test: Crash at every instruction boundary around verify/authorize/commit produces either old root or complete new root, never partial state.

title: Task contract
requirement: Bind raw request, acceptance criteria, protected dimensions, Unknown/subjective dimensions, side-effect policy, environment fixtures, initial project root, model/harness/tool contracts, budget, deadline, and fallback policy.
acceptance_test: Changing any contract field produces a different root and invalidates dependent certificates.

title: Model invocation contract
requirement: Bind provider/model/version, tokenizer or counting method, sampling, reasoning allowance, stopping policy, system prompt root, tool permission set, and routing fields observable to the harness.
theorem: Core: Harness Capability Superset; Pareto: Same-Harness Capability Superset
acceptance_test: Paired baseline/treatment manifests reject mismatched invocation fields.

title: Harness contract
requirement: Bind harness name/version, tool serialization, message ordering, transcript policy, cancellation semantics, native tool set, and adapter renderer version.
acceptance_test: Cross-harness comparisons identify renderer differences without invalidating semantic project objects.

title: Protected scope
requirement: Represent what equivalence/nonregression actually covers: tests, API, behavior, security, performance, file effects, user-visible output, and successor-state obligations.
theorem: Core: Protected decision equivalence; Pareto: protected quality
acceptance_test: An uncovered property is represented as Unknown and cannot be advertised as equivalent.

title: Native path preservation
requirement: Keep every ordinary harness tool and the complete non-ZeroStack execution path available to the model. ZeroStack is an optional strategy, not a mandatory bottleneck.
acceptance_test: A conformance task can disable ZeroStack mid-run and complete through the same native tool path.

title: Reasoning allowance preservation
requirement: The treatment arm must not lower the baseline model reasoning ceiling, stop condition, evidence authority, or tool authority. Actual consumption is measured separately.
theorem: Core: Harness Capability Superset; Pareto: Reasoning and Effect Floor
acceptance_test: Paired manifest checker fails any run with a smaller reasoning or tool contract.

title: Fallback reserve
requirement: Before speculation, reserve sufficient time, token, compute, and external-effect budget to restore or execute the baseline path after reusable speculative work is credited.
acceptance_test: Injected late failure still permits baseline completion within the bound, or speculation is refused before it begins.

title: Stable Zero Execute outer tool
requirement: Expose a small fixed-schema outer operation (conceptually zero.execute) whose tool definition and field order remain stable across tasks. Dynamic project details belong in arguments/results, not in schema mutation.
theorem: Core: Fixed Tool ABI Prefix Anchor; Q99: First-Emission Prefix Immunity
acceptance_test: Tool schema bytes remain identical across 10,000 randomized tasks; added capabilities are versioned rather than reordered in place.

title: Structured task submission
requirement: Translate harness calls into the canonical Task Contract without loss, implicit defaults, or unrooted side channels.
acceptance_test: Round-trip fixtures preserve every semantic field across CLI, RPC, native plugin, and optional MCP transports.

title: Typed result envelope
requirement: Return only typed outcomes: Completed, DecisionRequired, EvidenceExpansionRequired, VerificationUnknown, BaselineFallbackRequired, RejectedNoMutation, Cancelled, or FailedNoAuthority.
acceptance_test: Unknown, timeout, cancellation, and verifier disagreement cannot be rendered as Completed.

title: Opaque continuation handles
requirement: Map a short harness-visible handle to a rooted backend continuation. Handles are tenant/session scoped, revocable, non-authoritative, and resolve only through the backend.
acceptance_test: Forged/cross-tenant/stale handles fail; valid handles resume identical backend state without retransmitting prior project evidence.

title: Native-tool coexistence
requirement: Register ZeroStack alongside, not instead of, ordinary read/search/bash/edit tools. The adapter must not hide or shadow native tools unless the user explicitly configures it.
acceptance_test: Model can select either path in the same session; disabling adapter leaves native functionality unchanged.

title: Cancellation and deadline propagation
requirement: Propagate cancellation, deadlines, and budget changes into backend execution while preserving no-partial-authority semantics.
acceptance_test: Cancel during read, build, test, verify, and commit; authoritative root remains valid and receipts record cancellation.

title: Streaming without transcript flooding
requirement: Permit progress streaming to the UI or logs while keeping model-visible results bounded and stable. Progress events must not become semantic prompt content unless deliberately promoted.
acceptance_test: A long build produces large UI logs but a bounded model result plus exact expansion handle.

title: Cross-harness semantic/render split
requirement: Store harness-independent semantic decision views and derive canonical harness-specific renderings under renderer roots.
acceptance_test: Switching Pi/Codex/Claude/Cursor adapters reuses semantic roots; only render cache is invalidated.

title: Adapter conformance suite
requirement: Run the same rooted task through every adapter and compare protected outcome, project root, receipts, decision boundaries, and semantic resource projection.
acceptance_test: All adapters pass golden semantic equivalence; transport overhead differences are reported separately.

title: Rooted continuation state
requirement: Persist task root, project root, evidence roots, decision state, candidate state, verifier state, baseline reserve, and resource ledger under one continuation root.
acceptance_test: Resume after process restart produces identical state and does not require replaying model-visible history.

title: Continuation state machine
requirement: Implement explicit states: Bound, Snapshotted, Resolved, DecisionRequired, Planned, Executing, DeltaSealed, Verifying, Authorized, Committed, Restored, Rejected, Unknown, Cancelled.
acceptance_test: Every event has a total allowed-transition check; illegal transitions are rejected and audited.

title: Branching continuations
requirement: Create child continuations for alternative plans or model candidates without mutating the parent; permit convergence only through rooted equivalence/merge rules.
acceptance_test: Parallel branches can execute and one verified child can commit; losing branches leave no authority.

title: Continuation compaction without semantic loss
requirement: Compact internal event logs only after sealing a snapshot/root from which all authoritative state and audit obligations remain recoverable. Never rewrite provider-visible history to achieve backend log compaction.
acceptance_test: Replay before/after internal compaction yields identical authoritative state and audit roots.

title: Immutable content-addressed object store
requirement: Store exact bytes, parsed artifacts, graph fragments, results, receipts, deltas, and views by root. Objects are immutable; updates create new roots.
acceptance_test: Put/get round trips preserve exact bytes; attempted overwrite under same root is rejected.

title: Project snapshots
requirement: Construct immutable project snapshots covering files, modes, symlinks, relevant metadata, dependency lockfiles, toolchain contracts, and declared external inputs.
acceptance_test: Changing any covered project input changes snapshot root; excluded metadata is explicitly declared nonsemantic.

title: Exact reads and spans
requirement: Resolve files and exact source spans against a snapshot root, with preimage roots and path normalization.
acceptance_test: A span fails rather than silently drifting after source changes; line-ending/path alias variants canonicalize correctly.

title: Child sandbox snapshots
requirement: Create writable child workspaces from an immutable parent without modifying the parent. Track every file, process, network, environment, and generated-output effect.
acceptance_test: Sandbox escape, symlink traversal, undeclared network/process access, and parent writes are blocked or produce Unsafe.

title: Exact delta sealing
requirement: After execution, derive the complete canonical delta including generated files, modes, deletions, renames, formatter changes, and external-effect receipts.
acceptance_test: Independent rescan matches traced delta; hidden/untracked mutation causes verification failure.

title: Atomic compare-and-swap commit
requirement: Commit only when parent root/epoch, authorized delta root, protected scope, nonce, and lease remain exact.
acceptance_test: Two concurrent commits yield one success and one stale-root failure; replayed lease cannot mutate state.

title: Integrity scrubbing and replication
requirement: Periodically verify payload roots, repair from replicas, and distinguish logical L2 availability from physical L3 residency.
acceptance_test: Injected corruption is detected before reuse; replica recovery preserves the same root.

title: Retention and garbage collection
requirement: Retain objects reachable from live snapshots, continuations, receipts, authorities, and audit policy. GC must be root-safe and lease-aware.
acceptance_test: GC never deletes a reachable object; tombstone/reclamation races are fault-tested.

title: Tenant isolation and encryption
requirement: Namespace, authorize, and encrypt objects so roots or handles cannot leak cross-tenant data. Avoid content-dedup side channels across trust domains unless policy permits.
acceptance_test: Cross-tenant handle/root guessing yields no data or timing oracle beyond declared policy.

title: Incremental repository index
requirement: Maintain language-aware files, syntax trees, symbols, references, imports, calls, tests, configuration, build, generated artifacts, and ownership edges under exact snapshot roots.
acceptance_test: Known benchmark repos reproduce a full-rebuild index exactly after incremental updates.

title: Causal dependency graph
requirement: Represent deterministic constructors and every declared dependency: files, environment, tool versions, network fixtures, clocks/randomness policy, generated files, and verifier inputs.
acceptance_test: Synthetic hidden dependency changes cause a miss/Unknown until edge is added; no object outside closure is invalidated unnecessarily in complete fixtures.

title: Dependency assurance lattice
requirement: Grade graph regions as Proved, BoundedComplete, Observed, or Unknown. Only the first two may authorize omission/exact reuse inside their explicit scope.
acceptance_test: Observed-only graph never authorizes exact omission; assurance upgrades require evidence and are revocable.

title: Task-relative causal lens
requirement: Given task contract and candidate plan, return the demanded evidence/write closure, assurance grade, source roots, tests, interfaces, and unresolved ambiguities.
acceptance_test: Curated refactor tasks include every actual read/write/test dependency; omitted edge becomes a counterexample.

title: Executable closure checker
requirement: Given known values, cached objects, constructors, and demanded outputs, deterministically verify whether all outputs lie in the derivable closure.
acceptance_test: Checker agrees with exhaustive evaluation on finite DAG fixtures and rejects missing constructors/inputs.

title: Dependency-complete invalidation
requirement: On changed object/contract roots, invalidate the reflexive descendant cone for each authoritative certificate.
acceptance_test: Random DAG tests show no affected descendant is reused and no unrelated node loses key identity.

title: Equality-boundary early cutoff
requirement: Recompute boundary artifacts and stop downstream propagation when all separating boundary roots equal their prior roots.
acceptance_test: Syntactic changes yielding equal boundary values preserve downstream cache; unequal value propagates.

title: Counterexample-guided graph refinement
requirement: Capture actual undeclared influences from sandbox traces, add true missing edges, revoke dependent certificates, and retain counterexamples.
acceptance_test: Finite fixture converges after at most number of missing true edges under fair exercise.

title: Cross-branch convergence
requirement: Share objects across branches when complete causal key and payload root match; branch name alone is not identity.
acceptance_test: Independently built identical branch artifacts deduplicate; different dependencies do not.

title: Dynamic/runtime dependency adapters
requirement: Instrument build systems, test runners, interpreters, compilers, package managers, and selected runtime probes to discover nonstatic dependencies.
acceptance_test: Declared bounded domains reach BoundedComplete under adversarial dynamic access tests.

title: Semantic decision view
requirement: Construct a harness-independent rooted object containing exact relevant facts, protected uncertainty, candidate choices, evidence roots, and expansion authorities.
acceptance_test: Finite decision-family checker confirms merged states induce identical protected next decisions.

title: Stable capsule normal form
requirement: Represent large artifacts as causal key + formation receipt + payload root + stable capsule + expansion handle at first model exposure.
acceptance_test: Later expansion appends a new rooted result and never rewrites the previously emitted capsule.

title: Exact expansion
requirement: Resolve every omitted fact through a live rooted handle or return Unknown; never fabricate a summary-only recovery path.
acceptance_test: Expansion returns exact bytes/facts for original root; stale root is explicit.

title: Canonical provider rendering
requirement: Render stable system/tool/schema blocks, task arguments, views, references, and results deterministically for each adapter/model contract.
theorem: Core: Canonical Rendering Identity; Q99: Rendering Fragmentation Penalty
acceptance_test: Repeated rendering under randomized process/map order is byte-identical.

title: Append-only model history policy
requirement: Never retrospectively replace provider-visible prior messages or tool results. Evidence refinement appends a new message/reference under a new root.
acceptance_test: Longest common prefix of successive histories equals full previous history except provider/harness-required dynamic envelope fields explicitly excluded from the cache key.

title: Stable capsule admission policy
requirement: Estimate raw-vs-capsule horizon cost, expansion probability, handling cost, and complete resource vector before choosing indirection.
acceptance_test: Replay data predicts which representation wins; policy can be disabled when expansion burden dominates.

title: Volatility-aware commutative prefix ordering
requirement: Inside semantically commutative blocks, order long/stable material before volatile material according to measured survival score; never reorder noncommutative messages.
acceptance_test: Exhaustive small permutations confirm maximum expected prefix survival; semantic-order tests prevent illegal reordering.

title: Per-model token accounting
requirement: Count rendered tokens with the provider/model tokenizer when available and retain byte counts when not. Bind counting method/version in ledgers.
acceptance_test: Golden prompt fixtures match provider usage within documented accounting boundaries.

title: Decision-view sufficiency check
requirement: For finite or verifier-covered domains, prove the complete compatibility set maps to one protected decision; otherwise return Unknown/expand.
acceptance_test: Two compatible hidden states with distinct protected decisions always invalidate the view.

title: Mechanical operation graph
requirement: Represent read/search/index/build/test/format/analyze operations and their dependencies as a rooted DAG. Mark any node requiring model semantics as a decision boundary.
acceptance_test: Baseline traces can be annotated and operation graph never crosses a labeled semantic decision without a supplied contingent policy.

title: Private executor
requirement: Execute eligible operation DAG nodes without inserting intermediate results into model history; retain exact artifacts and receipts for expansion/audit.
acceptance_test: Model receives same protected decision information as primitive trace on fixture tasks; all intermediates remain recoverable.

title: Decision boundary return
requirement: Stop and return DecisionRequired when an unresolved semantic branch appears; include exact alternatives/evidence and continuation handle.
acceptance_test: Adversarial tasks requiring k adaptive decisions produce at least k returns unless model supplied a total contingent policy.

title: Contingent policy execution
requirement: Accept a model-supplied finite typed policy over reachable observation classes; verify every action before execution and return on unhandled class.
acceptance_test: Policy-covered branches stay within one call; injected unhandled observation returns DecisionRequired.

title: Critical-path scheduler
requirement: Parallelize independent operations while preserving deterministic semantic outputs and accounting actual work versus model-visible rounds.
acceptance_test: Parallel schedule matches sequential rooted outputs and reduces wall-clock only where dependencies permit.

title: Tool adapter registry
requirement: Wrap filesystem, search, AST, build, test, package, static-analysis, profiler, and external-service tools under rooted contracts and side-effect policies.
acceptance_test: Version/tool change invalidates dependent artifacts; undeclared effect is Unsafe.

title: Verifier registry
requirement: Bind verifier identity/version, scope, input roots, result, evidence, runtime, and confidence/assurance grade.
acceptance_test: Changing verifier version or scope invalidates authority.

title: Current-effect verification
requirement: Check build/tests/specification/static/security/performance obligations against the exact candidate delta and sandbox root.
acceptance_test: Substituting a different delta after verification fails authority validation.

title: Successor-state verification
requirement: Check that the committed state preserves required future interfaces/invariants or remains in the declared simulation relation, not merely that current tests pass.
acceptance_test: A locally passing edit that breaks a registered future action is rejected in a fixture.

title: Equivalence/dominance verdict
requirement: Return Equivalent, Dominates, Reject, or Unknown under protected scope. Unknown cannot be promoted by planner confidence.
acceptance_test: Verifier timeout/disagreement/uncovered dimension yields Unknown.

title: Authority lease issuance
requirement: Issue execution/commit authority only after verifying roots, scope, epoch, delta, verifier receipts, resource reserve, expiry, nonce, and caller identity.
theorem: Q99: Lease-Revocation Safety; Harness: Atomic No-Partial-Authority
acceptance_test: Replay/expiry/root mismatch/scope mismatch all fail before mutation.

title: Human/user acceptance gate
requirement: Represent subjective or policy decisions as explicit DecisionRequired/UserApproval rather than pretending automated equivalence.
acceptance_test: Greenfield/UX task cannot auto-claim subjective superiority without declared evaluator.

title: Proof/evidence cache
requirement: Cache verifier subresults under complete causal keys; invalidate on code, test, tool, environment, verifier, or scope changes and use equality early cutoff.
acceptance_test: Changed unrelated file preserves proof object; changed premise invalidates it.

title: Three-layer cache accounting
requirement: Measure L1 provider prefix cache, L2 logical causal-object reuse, and L3 physical residency separately.
acceptance_test: Forced L1 eviction with valid L2 produces provider miss but project logical hit; cold L3 is not mislabeled as L2 miss.

title: Provider cache telemetry
requirement: Capture cached-read, cache-write, uncached input, eligible prefix, route/model, TTL mode, cache key, and time-to-first-token when provider exposes them.
acceptance_test: Recorded values reconcile with provider usage response; missing fields are Unknown, not zero.

title: Causal reuse telemetry
requirement: For every request, record demanded weighted object set, valid reused set, invalid set, recomputed set, early-cutoff set, and reason codes.
acceptance_test: Mass accounting sums exactly and cannot count Unknown/invalid objects as hits.

title: Windowed Q99 service metric
requirement: Compute task-weighted reuse in declared sliding windows and report lower windows, post-change recovery, and impossibility events.
theorem: Q99: Windowed Q99; Adversarial Q99 Impossibility
acceptance_test: Central change exceeding 1% mass is reported as Q99 unavailable until threshold work is resolved.

title: Time/work to Q99
requirement: Track invalid mass resolved over time and compute exact remaining mass required to restore 99% valid reuse.
acceptance_test: Synthetic mutations match formula and never count unresolved mass as hit.

title: Rewrite crossover estimator
requirement: Estimate first-use write cost, cached-read cost, suffix size, compaction cost, and remaining reuse horizon before any retrospective representation change. Default remains first-emission stable capsules.
theorem: Q99: Cache-Compaction Crossover; Horizon-Aware Rewrite Break-Even
acceptance_test: Replay experiment predicts observed cost sign across providers/TTLs; no historical rewrite occurs in normal CCNF mode.

title: Cache frontier planner
requirement: Propose resident/materialized objects under storage, latency, and invalidation budgets using exact object costs and demand forecasts.
acceptance_test: Tree cases match DP optimum; general proposals pass independent capacity and closure checks even when heuristic.

title: Residency policy and prefetch
requirement: Separate logical validity from hot placement; prefetch high-hazard/high-demand closures without granting semantic authority based on prediction.
acceptance_test: Prediction errors alter latency/cost only; invalid object is never served as valid.

title: Q99 statistical certification
requirement: Compute exact/cluster-aware confidence intervals for hit rate and zero-failure bounds; do not infer universal Q99 from a handful of warm traces.
acceptance_test: 299 zero-miss independent trials are required for 99% at 95% one-sided support; clustered report uses stricter effective sample.

title: Complete resource ledger
requirement: Record calls, tool args/returns, uncached input, cache reads/writes, reasoning, visible output, wire/disk bytes, CPU/GPU, verification, latency, storage, preparation, maintenance, failed speculation, and restoration.
acceptance_test: Ledger reconciles to provider bills/system meters within declared tolerances; no hidden uncharged worker.

title: Paired baseline manifest
requirement: Run same model, harness, prompt, reasoning allowance, native tools, initial root, acceptance criteria, and meter scope with and without optional ZeroStack.
acceptance_test: Manifest diff must be empty outside treatment availability and randomized run metadata.

title: Separate cache metrics
requirement: Report provider prefix ratio, L2 valid causal reuse, L3 hot residency, Boundary-Q99, complete-work ratio, quality regression, strict rescue, and gap closure independently.
acceptance_test: Dashboard/API prevents one metric from being labeled as another.

title: Multi-resource feasibility solver
requirement: Given baseline/hit/fallback/preparation intervals and per-coordinate targets, compute exact feasible hit-rate intersection or blocker.
theorem: Pareto: Multi-Resource Pareto Feasibility; Robust Certificate
acceptance_test: Exact rational tests match exhaustive grid; reports coordinate causing impossibility.

title: Index amortization
requirement: Allocate indexing/object-formation cost over actual reuse campaign and compute strict/Q99 break-even horizons.
acceptance_test: No warm-run claim omits cold build; denominator nonpositive returns Impossible.

title: Frontier Closure decomposition
requirement: Compute normalized preparation, prepared-path, and novelty/fallback terms and identify the largest limiting burden.
acceptance_test: Terms are nonnegative and sum to complete optimized/baseline ratio.

title: Certified lower-bound ledger
requirement: Store disjoint charging maps for unavoidable request information, decisions, reasoning, verification, output, and effects.
acceptance_test: Overlap checker rejects double counting; closure Gamma never exceeds 1 under valid data.

title: Compression-dividend budget
requirement: Expose verified savings that may fund extra candidates/tests/proofs/reasoning without exceeding baseline resource vector.
acceptance_test: Augmentation scheduler refuses componentwise budget violation; strict rescue remains separately certified.

title: Capability asset lifetime ledger
requirement: Track capture/proof cost, reuse count, saved work, maintenance, invalidation hazard, strict rescue, and retirement decision.
acceptance_test: Assets with negative measured expected lifetime value are demoted/retired; invalid assets lose authority immediately.

title: Episode capture
requirement: After a successful task, propose exact evidence plans, causal lenses, operators, tests, failure syndromes, and decision capsules with source episode roots.
acceptance_test: Captured artifact is nonauthoritative until separately proved.

title: Scope and precondition proof
requirement: Bind every capability to repository/contract roots, explicit preconditions, reads, writes, postconditions, verifier, rollback, and invalidation dependencies.
acceptance_test: Similar but out-of-scope task does not match; changed dependency invalidates capability.

title: Shadow-mode promotion
requirement: Evaluate proposed capabilities alongside baseline before granting execution authority; require no protected regression under declared release gate.
acceptance_test: Promotion report includes misses, regressions, strict rescues, and complete cost.

title: Failure syndrome store
requirement: Retain proven-invalid approaches under exact domain/scope and use them only to prune branches covered by the proof.
acceptance_test: Out-of-scope syndrome cannot suppress candidate; in-scope invalid candidate is rejected with evidence.

title: Revocation/revalidation
requirement: Invalidate assets on dependency, contract, verifier, epoch, or policy changes; permit audit storage but remove execution authority until revalidated.
acceptance_test: Expired/revoked asset increases cost but cannot worsen protected result.

title: Sandbox confinement
requirement: Enforce filesystem namespace, process, network, environment, secret, device, and resource policies. Root all allowed external fixtures.
acceptance_test: Adversarial symlink, path traversal, subprocess, socket, environment, and secret-access tests fail closed.

title: Receipt and object poisoning defense
requirement: Verify roots, formation, producer, protected scope, and canonical encoding before cache reuse. When multi-tenant operation is enabled, additionally bind and verify tenant identity.
acceptance_test: Poisoned object/key and metadata tampering are rejected; cross-tenant substitution is additionally rejected when multi-tenant mode is enabled.

title: Authority replay protection
requirement: Use nonces, expiry, root/epoch binding, single-use or monotone commit semantics, and audit trail.
acceptance_test: Captured authority cannot be replayed after commit, rollback, branch switch, or epoch change.

title: Secret-safe rendering and logs
requirement: Redact or reference secrets before model-visible rendering and public traces while retaining verifiable private receipts under policy.
acceptance_test: Secret fixtures never appear in provider prompt, UI export, benchmark trace, or error string.

title: Crash recovery
requirement: Replay authoritative log, reconcile in-flight sandboxes/leases, and either complete a previously committed transaction or restore no-authority state.
acceptance_test: Kill/restart at every lifecycle state passes deterministic recovery fixtures.

title: Concurrency control
requirement: Support concurrent reads, branches, index updates, and candidates with snapshot isolation and root/epoch CAS at authority.
acceptance_test: Race tests preserve serializable authoritative roots; stale readers are explicit.

title: Observability and trace export
requirement: Export privacy-safe rooted traces, decision-boundary annotations, cache events, invalidation reasons, verification outcomes, and resource ledgers.
acceptance_test: Every benchmark result is reproducible from sealed manifests/ledgers or marked nonreproducible.

title: Schema and object migration
requirement: Migrate semantic objects through explicit deterministic transformations with old/new roots and validation receipts; retain compatibility or fail closed.
acceptance_test: Migration round trip/golden fixtures preserve meaning and invalidate only renderer/contract layers required.

title: Distributed worker trust
requirement: Treat workers as untrusted producers: accept outputs only after root, formation, sandbox, and verifier checks.
acceptance_test: Malicious worker output cannot acquire cache or commit authority.

title: Task manifest schema
requirement: Publish machine-readable manifests for explanation, refactor, port, and greenfield tasks with protected criteria and meter scope.
acceptance_test: Schema validation and root sealing pass for every released task.

title: Decision-boundary annotation
requirement: Double-annotate baseline traces into semantic decisions and mechanical segments using a blinded rubric.
acceptance_test: Inter-annotator agreement and adjudications are published; one/two-call claims match irreducible count.

title: Prefix policy trial
requirement: Compare raw-retained, retrospective-rewrite, and stable-capsule append-only histories under fixed provider prefix variables.
acceptance_test: Report LCP, cached/uncached/write tokens, cost, latency, quality, expansions.

title: Causal invalidation trial
requirement: Inject leaf, central, semantic-no-op, toolchain, environment, and branch changes; measure invalidated/recomputed mass and soundness. Record early-cutoff mass when the optional early-cutoff subsystem is enabled.
acceptance_test: No stale reuse; blast radius matches complete dependency model.

title: Provider-miss insulation trial
requirement: Warm both caches, independently force provider TTL/eviction/routing/model-key misses while preserving L2, and measure rediscovery avoided.
acceptance_test: Provider miss reprocesses compact view but does not relist/reread/reindex unchanged project.

title: Transactional fault matrix
requirement: Inject crashes, cancellation, stale roots, undeclared effects, verifier timeout/disagreement, storage corruption, and CAS races.
acceptance_test: Every case yields verified successor or exact no-mutation.

title: Windowed Q99 and recovery
requirement: Measure reuse across sliding windows and time/work-to-Q99 after controlled changes.
acceptance_test: Reports impossibility intervals rather than averaging them away.

title: Paired quality evaluation
requirement: Blindly compare same-model/same-harness outputs for regression, strict rescue, factual support, test/build results, and subjective dimensions.
acceptance_test: Treatment cannot claim no degradation outside verifier/human scope.

title: Release claim gate
requirement: Automate checks for paper theorem status, current-provider fact date, citation resolution, no unsupported Q99 substitution, benchmark evidence, checksums, and negative results.
acceptance_test: Release fails when any required artifact or claim scope is absent.

title: Durable continuation compatibility
requirement: Bind every continuation handle to ABI, task, project, security, model/harness rendering, and epoch roots. Resolve through explicit migration or fail closed; a handle is never authority.
acceptance_test: Handles survive process restart and compatible adapter changes, while stale, cross-project, incompatible-ABI, or forged handles fail without mutation.

title: Stable Zero Execute surface
requirement: Expose one small stable semantic tool surface whose schema does not change with project contents. Dynamic state is carried through rooted arguments, capsules, and continuation handles.
theorem: V6: Stable harness surface and provider-prefix preservation
acceptance_test: Project/index growth does not alter the registered tool schema; canonical conformance fixtures render deterministically.

title: Cross-adapter semantic replay
requirement: Replay canonical task/result vectors through at least three transports and verify equivalent protected semantic roots, cancellation, timeout, Unknown, fallback, and ledger behavior.
acceptance_test: Faithful adapters differ only in declared rendering/transport fields and produce the same authoritative backend transition.

title: Decision-view completeness witness
requirement: Every compact view must identify the protected decisions it supports, exact evidence roots, omitted classes, expansion handles, completeness grade, and baseline escape.
acceptance_test: Removing a needed evidence class causes Unknown or a failed certificate; exact expansion reproduces the bound object.

title: Unresolved semantic decision gate
requirement: Detect observation-contingent branches not covered by a user/model contingent policy or a uniquely resolving verifier and return DecisionRequired before authority is exercised.
acceptance_test: Injected hidden semantic branches cannot be privately selected; purely mechanical branches remain privately composable.

title: Demand-weight ledger
requirement: Record the exact demanded object closure and positive per-object demand weights for each declared Q99 coordinate and window. Denominators include misses and Unknown objects.
acceptance_test: Q99 report is rejected when demanded objects, weights, window, tier, or validity semantics are absent or inconsistent.

title: Residency-plan proposal and verifier
requirement: Allow heuristics/solvers to propose L3 resident sets, but independently verify capacity and retained valid demand mass before issuing a tier-specific Q99 certificate.
acceptance_test: Checker accepts exactly plans within capacity retaining at least the declared threshold; optimizer and authority are separate modules.

title: Q99 eviction slack guard
requirement: Before eviction, compute current resident valid demand mass, Q99 slack, proposed removed mass, and post-eviction certificate. Deny or compensate any eviction that violates a declared service threshold.
acceptance_test: Adversarial eviction just below slack passes; just above slack fails unless compensating admission restores the threshold.

title: L2-valid/L3-cold recovery
requirement: Distinguish logically valid objects from physical residency. An L3 miss fetches or deterministically rematerializes the valid L2 object without relisting/reindexing unchanged project state.
acceptance_test: Forced local eviction preserves L2 validity and produces a measured fetch/rematerialization path rather than project rediscovery.

title: Provider-miss bounded amplification metric
requirement: Measure baseline replay burden B, compact decision-view burden C, continuation overhead L, and complete backend work after forced provider misses; report 1-(C+L)/B only for the model-visible coordinate.
acceptance_test: Report includes all backend work separately and rejects the ratio when scopes or denominators differ.

title: Cross-session and branch deduplication
requirement: Reuse exact L2 objects across sessions, branches, and faithful harness adapters by canonical content/contract/dependency identity while preserving security and tenancy authorization.
acceptance_test: Identical roots deduplicate physically and logically; cross-tenant unauthorized resolution fails; branch labels do not fragment semantic identity.

title: Certified unavoidable-work lower bound
requirement: Represent request, irreducible decision, protected reasoning, verification, output, and external-effect lower-bound components with scope and nonoverlap evidence.
acceptance_test: Closure report rejects L>Z, overlapping lower-bound components, or mismatched baseline/treatment scopes.

title: Reasoning allowance sovereignty audit
requirement: Capture baseline and treatment reasoning settings, tool access, context escape, stopping policy, and fallback reserve. Prevent claims of no degradation when treatment removes any baseline reasoning or tool strategy.
acceptance_test: Changing treatment reasoning limit or disabling a native tool invalidates the no-degradation certificate.

title: Adaptive decision-depth annotation
requirement: Blindly annotate baseline traces for genuine observation-contingent semantic decisions and compare with Zero Execute call count and hidden-segment classifications.
acceptance_test: Dataset records disagreements and fails any task where treatment hides an uncounted semantic decision.

title: Residency capacity/Q99 curve
requirement: Measure minimum RAM/disk capacity required to retain 99% valid demanded mass under observed workloads; compare LRU, LFU, size-aware, causal-weighted, and oracle plans.
acceptance_test: Every reported plan is independently checked for capacity/Q99 and optimizer time is separated from checker time.

title: L1/L2/L3 forced-miss matrix
requirement: Independently force provider-prefix miss, local-residency miss, logical invalidation, and combinations; measure rediscovery, transfer, rematerialization, model-visible tokens, and complete work.
acceptance_test: Results distinguish all layers and never label L3 coldness or L1 eviction as L2 invalidity.

title: Invisible steady-state budget
requirement: Measure and enforce default idle/background targets near <=0.1% CPU and <=500 MB resident memory; schedule heavier indexing explicitly and disclose alternate modes.
acceptance_test: Long-duration idle and incremental-update tests stay within the configured budget or fail the release gate with measured evidence.

title: Cross-project cache isolation
requirement: Separate semantic deduplication from authorization. Content-equivalent objects may share physical storage, but handles, reads, capabilities, and receipts are scoped to authorized tenants/projects.
theorem: V6: Content reuse without authority reuse
acceptance_test: Cross-project guessed roots or handles cannot reveal payloads or issue authority; authorized identical content can deduplicate.

title: Capability lifetime and Q99 interaction
requirement: Charge capability capture, proof, maintenance, residency, invalidation, and revalidation; prioritize only assets whose verified lifetime value and causal reuse justify cost.
theorem: V6: capability is an optional cacheable strategy, not free memory
acceptance_test: Failed captures and stale assets remain in the ledger; low-value assets are retired without removing baseline strategy.

title: Versioned cumulative claim authority
requirement: Ship the current correction/supersession table and reject runtime or documentation claims that cite a superseded formulation as current authority.
acceptance_test: Release checker flags Draft 4 rewrite formula, model-internal one-token framing, or ambiguous Q99 percentage when used without current scope.
